scope: Original content for four limited client-preview journey pages, expanding the existing homepage routes. This is proposed itinerary content, not verified bookable inventory.
editorial_rules: Every lead explicitly identifies the route as suggested.
Day counts and overnight locations match the existing homepage duration and stage distribution.
Arrival and departure fields identify itinerary endpoints, not guaranteed transport connections.
Travel days do not contain unsourced drive times, supplied vehicles or transfer promises.
Meals, boats, temple visits, guides, admissions and accommodation are not presented as confirmed inclusions.
No rates, discounts, availability, priority-access guarantees, invented service standards or customer claims are used.
Optional Gaya is separate from Bodh Gaya and its Buddhist focus.
Walking and rest notes support planning without promising accessibility or assistance.
Prose is original. Source websites supply factual destination context and visit constraints only.

route_validation.structure: Arrival day, Varanasi day, Sarnath day, departure day.
route_validation.planning_constraint: Sarnath museum afternoon may need swapping around Friday. A boat ride is optional and conditional on local conditions.

route_validation.structure: Three nights in Varanasi with Sarnath, a transfer and Sangam day in Prayagraj, a transfer to Ayodhya, temple-focused departure day.
route_validation.planning_constraint: Final departure must leave sufficient time for chosen temple visits and queues. No darshan pass type, exact duration or access privilege is promised.

route_validation.structure: Varanasi arrival, Sarnath day, dedicated intercity travel day, Mahabodhi and selected monasteries, flexible departure.
route_validation.planning_constraint: A separate Gaya visit is optional and depends on the onward schedule. A ritual-focused visit may require additional time; no ritual service or meditation programme is implied.

route_validation.structure: Lucknow arrival and city day, transfer to Agra and monument day, transfer to Vrindavan and a Braj day, flexible departure.
route_validation.planning_constraint: If the full Agra day is Friday, move the Taj visit only when arrival or departure logistics allow, otherwise adjust the stay. Mathura is optional rather than an obligatory extra stop.
